text:
ana (marketing): Team — prepping the SprintLabs Quickstart OSS refapp + 15m tutorial. Plan: blog post + gated webinar + benchmark gist. Target launch next Wed. Need quick input: benchmark narrative, webinar hook, RSVP routing, and post-webinar nurture.

rui (devrel): Nice. For benchmark story: show sample workload (3-turn chat, seq=128) and surface latency distribution (p50/p95) plus cost-per-1k-tokens. Call out the real-world prompt set we used. Keep visuals simple.

nina (growth): RSVP gating: 1 short MCQ (primary use case: prototype / product / infra). Route to nurture flows: proto-track, product-track, infra-track. Use utm_source param per channel.

omar (engineer): Repo ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sprintlabs-quickstart. Bench script: `./bench/run.sh --concurrency 8 --seq 128 --model redwood/small` — outputs CSV + summary JSON.

jade (events): Webinar length? 30m live: 10m demo, 10m bench walkthrough, 10m q&a. Wed 9am PT preferred. Speakers: ana + rui demo, omar infra notes.

ci-bot: Staging preview deployed at https://sprintlabs-preview.redwood.ai — pipeline #578 passed :white_check_mark:

rui (devrel): Draft copy: Blog blurb — "SprintLabs Quickstart: spin up a sample refapp, run a reproducible benchmark, and tune for latency & cost." Tweet: "SprintLabs Quickstart — OSS refapp + 15m tutorial for fast LLM features. Live demo Wed 9am PT. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/sprintlabs (utm=tw)"

ana (marketing): tiny tweak: mention "reproducible benchmark" in the blurb and add "includes demo scripts and k8s manifest".

nina (growth): For routing: funnel RSVPs to `/workflows/sprintlabs-webinar`. Tag contacts `sprintlabs_rsvp`. Post-webinar: 1) immediate email with link to repo + JSON report 2) a follow-up focused on next steps by track.

omar (engineer): We'll run the bench live during demo: command to run: `./bench/run.sh --save-report /tmp/report.json` and we'll `aws s3 cp /tmp/report.json s3://redwood-sprintlabs/reports/`. Sample output: `\{\"p50_ms\": 42, \"p95_ms\": 98, \"cost_per_1k\": \"$0.09\"\}`.

jade (events): Ops checklist: 1) webinar landing page + form 2) rehearsal + 2-min teaser clip 3) slides + demo script 4) tracking & UTMs 5) infra on-call for live bench. Who owns teaser clip?

ana (marketing): I'll create slides + blog. rui — you own demo script + short social clips. nina — you own registration flow + tags. omar — infra + report shape. jade — events logistics.

rui (devrel): I'll add 3 prompts to the tutorial to show caching benefits (cold vs warm runs). Also will record a 90s demo snippet during rehearsal.

nina (growth): Suggest A/B subject lines for post-webinar email: A) "Your SprintLabs benchmark + quickstart" B) "See how we got 42ms p50 — SprintLabs results". I'll run 50/50.

omar (engineer): Note: numbers vary by instance. We'll include a short note: "test infra: g5.x/8 (dev) vs a100 (prod) typical ranges" in the report.

ci-bot: Calendar invite created: 2026-05-SPRLABS-02. Reminder scheduled for speakers.

jade (events): Rehearsal Wed (one day before) 30m block. Please confirm availability.

ana (marketing): Confirmed. Quick ask: can we get a 1-line customer-facing value prop for social? Something like: "Ship LLM features faster with reproducible benchmarks & production tuning."

rui (devrel): That works. I'll sync on demo order and attach GH issue with checklist.

nina (growth): I'll prepare the two-email sequence (reminder & post-webinar with report link). Share copy by Fri EOD.

ana (marketing): Great — next check Mon 9am PT. Adding PR links and landing page draft in the thread when ready. :rocket:
